title: Individual receipt, program proof-class, and canonical closure vocabulary map
purpose: Make every cross-repository vocabulary transition explicit so collaborators can compare individual assurance receipts, program proof classes, and the four grouped canonical closure families without treating similar labels as interchangeable by implication.

source_contracts.contract: site-reading-governance simulated substantive receipt closure schema

family_mappings.aggregation_rule: Aggregate version-pinned vendor receipts only when each receipt binds its environment, identity, fixture, operation, readback, limitation, and evidence locator.
Aggregate migration, rollback, restore, continuity, and data-exit receipts against one declared representative corpus and recovery objective.
Aggregate identity, tenant isolation, configuration, credential lifecycle, privacy, telemetry, support, and incident receipts against one declared control profile.
Preserve the Scientific decision as a distinct role-bound decision over the shared immutable acceptance basis.
Preserve the Quality decision as a distinct role-bound decision over the shared immutable acceptance basis.
Preserve the Regulatory decision as a distinct role-bound decision over the shared immutable acceptance basis.
Bind each engineering verification receipt to one explicit grouped family through stable scenario and test identifiers; the category alone selects no family.

status_mappings.condition: The receipt and canonical closure bind the same future-reality identity, evidence mode, scope, and immutable evidence digest.
Every environment-observed successor remains outside the simulated closure and retains its own accountable evidence path.

semantic_invariants: A family mapping preserves evidence mode, authority, intended use, limitations, and source coordinates.
A grouped canonical family closes only when every required constituent proof shape closes inside the same selected future reality.
A closed simulation status grants no production authorization and supplies no environment-observed acceptance.
An observed successor advances through its own evidence and accountable decision path.
Engineering verification selects an assurance family only through an explicit named-family binding.
